text:
Nora: Heads-up — late-week surge for GPU arrivals. Need clear owners for unpack/QA + mapping to reservation slots. ETA for next crates: Mon 3/31 (local). Link to manifest: https://internal.manifests/munge/1749

Jamal: Got it. Which racks are we targeting in DC-east vs DC-west? Any specific PDUs we need to reserve?

Priya: I can own unpacking at DC-east. I need power slots and a list of serials we expect so my team can pre-stage cables.

Ken: I can take validation and firmware on the east nodes after unpack. What's the firmware window? also need owner for BMC creds rotation.

Bea: Question on reservations: do we map these nodes to Dedicated capacity immediately or hold as staging until canary passes? We should avoid double-booking with hosted pool.

inventory-bot: Manifest updated: 12 GPUs scheduled for 2027-03-31 arrival. Serial list: sent to #inventory (private). Tracking ID: INV-2027-1749.

Nora: Bea — prefer hold as staging for 48h canary unless an enterprise customer has a hard SLA. We'll surface exceptions. Jamal: DC-west will get 8 GPUs (racks 14-16), DC-east gets 4 (racks 2-3).

Jamal: Ack. I'll reserve PDUs on racks 14-16 and post power windows.

Priya: FYI packing manifests show one crate with mixed SKUs; that complicates automated node-naming. There's a script that assumes uniform SKU.

Ken: That script is in infra/tools/node-nameer, PR #4212. I need a quick CR on the flexible-parsing patch. ping @eng-infra for review?

Bea: On reservation service: current flow auto-allocates nodes to hosted if tag==available. We need a short patch to add a staging tag to avoid host assignment. Who can ship that by Wed EOD?

Nora: Jamal — can you take the staging-tag change in reservation-service? It's a small opt-in flag. If not, I'll ask platform.

Jamal: I can pick it up. Will create a small feature branch and flag it behind a feature toggle. ETA Wed EOD.

Priya: For the node-naming: temporary workaround is manual mapping in the unpack sheet. I'll coordinate with inventory and push names to the provisioning queue.

Ken: Added CR request comment on #4212. If someone can approve today I can start validation on arrival day.

Bea: Also, need an owner to run the canary deployment (traffic routing + latency checks). Prefer ops or runtime to take that.

Nora: I'll reach out to runtime team via DM and ask for a canary lead. If runtime can't, Ken — can your team run a minimal canary?

Ken: We can run a minimal canary (10% traffic, synthetic workloads). Need the routing playbook updated with the new rack names.

Nora: Action items: Priya = unpack east, Jamal = reservation staging tag + PDUs, Ken = firmware/validation + canary fallback if runtime declines, Bea = reservation policy exceptions. I'll follow up with a short doc and a canary schedule.

Jamal: One more — weekend oncall coverage for initial burn-in? We should add a short rotation so issues don't pile.

Nora: Agreed. I'll add weekend slots to the ops calendar and ping rotations.

Bea: sgtm. If anyone hits a blocker on naming or reservation conflicts, post here and tag me.

Ken: Quick note — for firmware we need netlink up before flashing; if NICs are flaky we'll fallback to USB netconsole. Keeping that in my checklist.

Priya: Copy. I'll bring extra flash USBs.

inventory-bot: Reminder scheduled: cargo arrival 2027-03-31 09:00 local. Attachments: crate manifests (private).

Nora: Thanks all — I'll spin up a follow-up thread with the canary window and CR links shortly. :thumbsup:
